Hi Jane / Procurement team — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have a clear procurement path: 

- Recap: Acme wants Redwood for inference on product search (pilot 3 months, then expansion) — estimated monthly spend ~$18k.
- Procurement options discussed: PO (preferred by your finance), card for pilot, or AWS Marketplace if you want consolidated billing.
- Coupa/Ariba: you mentioned Coupa is preferred. To create a Purchase Requisition (PR) we typically need either a supplier ID in Coupa or for your team to create a one-off PR to our supplier record.

Can you confirm: 1) whether you will open a PR against an existing supplier entry for "Redwood Inference," 2) if you need us to complete a supplier onboarding form for Coupa, and 3) approximate timeline for PR creation?

If you prefer, we can also accept a corporate card for the pilot to avoid delays and then convert to PO for the committed rollout. Let me know which route is faster for your team.

Next steps I propose:
1) If Coupa: please share supplier ID (or let me know and I will loop in our finance to complete onboarding).
2) If PO: confirm billing contact and the PO template we'll receive.
3) If Marketplace: say whether AWS Marketplace or GCP Marketplace is required and we can provide the listing/quote.

I've added HubSpot deal HS-2026-00421 to the thread for reference. Happy to jump on a 15-min call with your procurement owner if helpful.

Thanks,
Camila
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
camila.reyes@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0122

Hi Camila,

Thanks for the clear summary. A few answers from procurement at Acme: 

- We do prefer to use Coupa for anything over $5k/month; we will open a PR against a supplier record.
- I don't see a current supplier record for "Redwood Inference" in our Coupa instance.
- For a pilot, our procurement can issue a short-term PO if finance approves, but we need supplier onboarding completed first.

Can you have your finance/procurement team fill out our supplier onboarding form and provide a W-9 + vendor banking instructions? If you already have a Redwood supplier ID in Coupa (or Ariba), please send it over.

Timeline: we can create the PR within 3–5 business days after supplier is created. If you can accept a card for the first month, we can start sooner while Coupa is being set up.

Thanks,
Jane Liu
Head of Procurement | Acme Analytics
